name: Sayaka Kitahara career
content: Sayaka Kitahara's career highlights: Hello! Project Egg (2004-2011); MilkyWay unit for Kirarin Revolution (anime tie-in, Oricon top-10 singles); Voice of Sorano Aoi in Inazuma Eleven GO; Mei Izumi in THE IDOLM@STER Shiny Colors; Two photobooks released in 2025 (Hanpanai Desho?, Tokonatsu no Yoin) via Young Jump gravure series

name: Sayaka Kitahara personal
content: About Sayaka Kitahara: Born November 29, 1993 in Saitama, Japan; affiliated with Ken Production. Hobbies: cooking, singing, tennis, collecting hand towels, fishing, action games; favorite color is strong pink.

name: Sayaka Kitahara voice
content: Sayaka Kitahara's speaking style: No interview material found in English; her persona is the cheerful idol-turned-voice-actress — bright, polite, hobby-driven. Inferred: warm, earnest, fan-friendly with classic Japanese idol politeness.
